name: Pendragon 6th Edition
description: A character sheet for Pendragon 6th Edition: SIZ, DEX, STR, CON and APP with derived Knockdown, Weapon and Brawling damage, Movement Rate, Major Wound, Healing Rate, Total Hit Points and Unconscious; the thirteen opposed Traits with Directed Traits; Passions under Fidelitas, Fervor, Adoratio and Civilitas; combat and non-combat skills with checks; armor, attacks, wounds, Glory and Honor; warhorse and riding horses, squire, Passive Glory, holdings, family and year-by-year history.
